misprints.note: Letters missing in hvarandra; kept as printed.
Printed without breathings, which looks like a printer's error.
No accent in the print; the same thing happens again in 0470_02 (Tvåfotad).
Kept as printed; probably an intended abbreviation.
The mark looks like a full stop, though a comma was probably meant; kept as a full stop.

uncertain.note: The print shows 't..', where the second mark could be a comma with a broken tail; I wrote 't.,'.
The mark over η is odd and looks like breathing plus a grave accent (broken type?); I kept ἡ.
The breathing could be read as smooth or rough; I kept the smooth breathing as it appears in the print.
I cannot see an iota subscript in the print; ῇ is possible.
The closing parenthesis is broken or faint in the print.
The punctuation after tiderymd could be a full stop or a comma.
